title: TaskUpdate Metadata — Tier 3 (Minimal, special nesting)
description: Minimal metadata for the TaskUpdate tool. IMPORTANT: TaskUpdate already uses a 'metadata' parameter as an arbitrary user-data object. ATS metadata MUST be nested under the '_dgm' key within that existing metadata object. Same collision avoidance pattern as TaskCreate.

notes.nesting_collision: Same as task-create.schema.json — ATS goes in metadata._dgm.
notes.merge_semantics: TaskUpdate uses merge semantics for metadata — setting _dgm key won't overwrite other metadata keys.
